lineage.strategy: Use a fresh product-pricing source exposing capacity monetization mechanics rather than repeat contract or quarterly-result evidence.

observations.fact: Nebius introduced dynamic spot pricing for preemptible VMs, using available capacity and real-time user-demand signals to price interruptible GPU compute and monetize temporarily idle capacity.

risks.risk: Dynamic spot pricing can improve utilization but the source provides no realized utilization uplift, revenue contribution, gross-margin effect or cannibalization data.

unknowns.unknown: Measured revenue, utilization and margin impact of dynamic spot pricing are not yet disclosed.

recommendation: Use as fresh execution evidence for capacity monetization; do not infer financial magnitude until operating data are reported.
